pmc-11354387.description: The development of products with skin-protective effects has been driven by the increasing incidence of skin diseases that are exacerbated by increasing pollution, urbanization, poor living, working, fatigue, dietary habits, and general treatment. The ability of antioxidants to protect the skin from oxidative stress and its effects makes them one of the most important ingredients in today’s cosmetics.

pmc-11445090.title: HGGL-03 DIFFUSE MIDLINE GLIOMA IN GHANA-AN ILL-FATED DIAGNOSIS
pmc-11445090.creator: Sedinam Adamaley, Hafisatu Gbadamosi, Ernestina Schandorf, Mary-ann Dadzie, Patrick Bankah, Yaw Boateng Mensah, Henry Adrah, JuliaEbo Tawiah
pmc-11445090.description: PURPOSEDiffuse midline gliomas (DMG) based on the updated WHO classification are pediatric-type diffuse high-grade gliomas common in children and young adults. They are highly aggressive with dismal outcomes. Unfortunately, not much is known about these tumours in Ghana. This study seeks to provide initial data on the subject.

pmc-11525338.title: Embracing the challenges of neonatal and paediatric pulmonary hypertension
pmc-11525338.creator: Dunbar Ivy, Erika B. Rosenzweig, Steven H. Abman, Maurice Beghetti, Damien Bonnet, Johannes Menno Douwes, Alessandra Manes, Rolf M.F. Berger
pmc-11525338.description: Paediatric pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) shares common features with adult disease, but is associated with several additional disorders and challenges that require unique approaches. This article discusses recent advances, ongoing challenges and distinct approaches for caring for infants and children with PAH, as presented by the paediatric task force of the 7th World Symposium on Pulmonary Hypertension.

pmc-12591693.title: Successful Management of Vaginal Cuff Dehiscence With Peritonitis by Elective Laparoscopic-Assisted Repair: A Case Report
pmc-12591693.creator: Sho Kudo, Hideaki Tsuyoshi, Akiko Shinagawa, Makoto Orisaka, Yoshio Yoshida
pmc-12591693.description: Vaginal cuff dehiscence (VCD) is a rare complication of total laparoscopic hysterectomy (TLH); the incidence rate has been reported to be 1.27%. However, a definitive treatment strategy has not yet been established. To our knowledge, we report the first case of VCD that was successfully managed with elective laparoscopic-assisted vaginal repair following initial conservative antibiotic therapy.

pmc-12613676.title: Assessment of the canalis sinuosus and its branches in Taiwanese individuals using cone beam computed tomography
pmc-12613676.creator: Ting-Hsuan Wu, Yen-Wen Shen, Lih-Jyh Fuh, Heng-Li Huang, Jui-Ting Hsu
pmc-12613676.description: BackgroundThe popularity of dental implant surgeries, particularly in the maxillary anterior region, is growing, and understanding variations in relevant anatomical structures such as the canalis sinuosus (CS) and its accessory canals (ACs) is critical to avoid complications, including nerve injury and tissue necrosis.

pmc-12750818.title: High-density lipoprotein 2b combined with sequential organ failure assessment score as a novel prognostic indicator for sepsis patients: a prospective study
pmc-12750818.creator: Yuting Chen, Yichun Jiang, Andi Xia, Zewei Huang, Zhenmi Liu, Chengying Hong, Yaowang Lin, Xueyan Liu
pmc-12750818.description: BackgroundSepsis is a state of life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection, leading to consecutive organ failure and lethal outcome. The purpose of this study is to assess the value of the combined use of plasma high-density lipoprotein 2b (HDL2b) level and Sequential Organ Failure Assessment (SOFA) score in predicting short-term mortality from sepsis.

pmc-12975127.title: Large-scale identification of plasma membrane repair proteins revealed spatiotemporal cellular responses to plasma membrane damage
pmc-12975127.creator: Yuta Yamazaki, Keiko Kono, Pablo S Aguilar, Yuta Yamazaki, Keiko Kono
pmc-12975127.description: Damage to the plasma membrane (PM) is common in all types of cells. PM repair processes, including exocytosis and endocytosis, are not mutually exclusive; rather, they collaborate to repair the wound. However, the temporal coordination between the repair processes remains poorly understood.

pmc-13161660.title: Eye movement analysis during working memory tasks correlates with cognitive, clinical, and anatomical metrics in multiple sclerosis
pmc-13161660.creator: Cecilie Fjeldstad Pardo, Gerardo Fernandez, Bujana Allushi, Adithya A Bhaktaram, Lorna Galleguillos, Danilo Verge, Gabriel Pardo
pmc-13161660.description: BackgroundCognitive dysfunction involving working memory is common in multiple sclerosis (MS) but is often under-detected in clinical assessments. Noninvasive digital biomarkers like oculomotor metrics may enhance the detection of neurofunctional changes.ObjectiveDetermine whether oculomotor metrics during a visuospatial N-back task reflect cognitive dysfunction and correspond with clinical measures in patients with MS.

pmc-13182717.title: Beta-Lactam Plus Azithromycin or Doxycycline vs Fluoroquinolones in Adult Patients Hospitalized With Community-Acquired Pneumonia: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-analysis
pmc-13182717.creator: Magdoleen H Farah, Mohamed Abusalih, Wigdan Farah, Mohamad El Labban, Qusay Haydour, Neha Ramachandran, Zhen Wang, Erin F Barreto, Larry Prokop, M Hassan Murad, Yewande Odeyemi
pmc-13182717.description: BackgroundCommunity-acquired pneumonia (CAP) is a significant public health concern associated with increased rates of hospital admissions and mortality. The purpose of the current study was to compare beta-lactam plus azithromycin or doxycycline vs fluoroquinolones in adults hospitalized with CAP.MethodsWe searched several databases from inception to 10 June 2024. Two reviewers independently screened, selected, and extracted data.

pmc-13200152.title: Altered social and cognitive control interactions during decision-making in social anxiety
pmc-13200152.creator: Yiman Li, Nicholas T Van Dam, Zhihao Wang, Yuejia Luo, Pengfei Xu
pmc-13200152.description: BackgroundSocial anxiety is characterized by fear and avoidance of social situations, yet many everyday decisions are made in the presence of others and are shaped by social influence. However, the influences of social anxiety on social decision-making and the underlying neural processes are not well understood.

pmc-13239145.title: Seroprevalence and Risk Factors of Toxocara spp. in Dogs, Cats, and Their Owners in the City of Villavicencio, Colombia: Interaction With the “One Health” Approach
pmc-13239145.creator: María Alejandra Velásquez Peña, Chaira Liz Angelica Vasquez-Turriago, Adolfo Vásquez-Trujillo, Dumar Alexander Jaramillo-Hernández, Lipi Buch
pmc-13239145.description: Background Toxocara spp. is one of the most neglected zoonotic soil‐transmitted helminths worldwide, causing toxocariasis in humans. The objective of this study was to determine the seroprevalence of Toxocara spp. in dogs, cats, and their owners, the coprodiagnostic incidence in dogs and cats, the risk factors, and association with atopy in owners of these pets.

pmc-13364113.creator: Suyue Liu, Dazhao Zhou, Jinghua Lin, Jifang Tao
pmc-13364113.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Piezoelectric pressure sensors for dynamic monitoring face a trade-off between charge output and measurement range, and existing high-sensitivity designs are largely confined to narrow ranges. This study presents a composite layered piezoelectric pressure sensor in which a 316L stainless-steel diaphragm drives a centrally suspended PZT-5H wafer supported by a perforated alumina gasket, with the wafer thickness and cavity radius optimized under a 10 MPa full-scale stress constraint.
